decisive_items: a large right retroperitoneal predominantly fatty mass in the location of the right adrenal gland
a well-defined, encapsulated retroperitoneal lesion of mostly fat density with internal areas of soft-tissue density
soft-tissue nodular and linear strand-like areas showing mild enhancement on post-contrast images
response.rationale: The imaging features are classic for adrenal myelolipoma: a predominantly fatty, well-encapsulated retroperitoneal mass in the adrenal location with soft-tissue components and no invasion. R1 is the most specific diagnosis; R2 names the same entity but omits the adrenal localization.

rejected.why: A lipoma would be a pure fatty mass without the soft-tissue nodular and enhancing components seen here.
A teratoma can contain fat and soft tissue, but the adrenal location and absence of calcific or mature cystic elements favor myelolipoma.
